hints.title: Safety Net Suffix Array
hints.text: Precompute array right[j] storing the earliest index in word1 from which the suffix word2[j:] can be matched completely without any mismatch.

hints.title: Greedy Leftmost Matching
hints.text: Iterate through word2 from left to right. To make the sequence lexicographically smallest, choose the smallest possible index in word1 for each position.

hints.title: Mismatch Spending Condition
hints.text: If word1[i] does not equal word2[j], use the single allowed mismatch only if right[j + 1] > i, ensuring the remaining suffix can still be matched.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Backward scan takes O(n + m). Forward greedy construction takes O(n + m).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive backtracking or recursion over mismatch possibilities causes TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) memory for the suffix safety table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes suffix availability to guide greedy forward index selection.
